q: Is DSU Online approved by the UGC?

q: Can I apply for multiple programs at DSU Online?
a: Yes. A student can pursue two academic programmes, one in full time physical mode and another in Open and Distance Learning ( ODL ) / Online Mode ; or upto two ODL / Online Programmes simultaneously

q: Is the online BBA /B.Com / BCA / MBA / MCA degree equal to a regular degree?
a: Yes. DSU’s online degree courses are equivalent to traditional on‑campus degrees, as per UGC guidelines, and are recognized across industries and for higher studies.

q: Are the online degrees from DSU Online recognized and valid?
a: Yes, all degrees offered through DSU Online are recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the university is NAAC A+ accredited. These degrees are fully valid and hold the same academic weight as traditional on‑campus degrees.

q: Is DSU a government‑recognized university?

q: How flexible is the MBA programme for working professionals?
a: The programme is 100% online with flexible schedules, offering evening or weekend classes, live and recorded sessions, with self-paced learning modules that are accessible 24/7 to accommodate working professionals.

q: Will an online MBA provide the same networking opportunities?
a: Yes. Students gain access to virtual networking events, discussion forums, mentorship, webinars with industry leaders for enhanced professional connections.

a: The academic calendar will be published with timelines.

q: Are there opportunities for practical and experiential learning in the MBA programme?
a: Yes, the programme includes case studies, internships, projects, industry-focused assignments to enhance real-world business skills.

q: Is the MBA programme accredited and globally recognised?
a: Yes. Dayananda Sagar University is accredited by NAAC with A+ and adheres to international academic standards, making the degree globally recognised and valued.

q: Is the course study material available online?
a: Yes. The course study material of the online programme will be available through the University’s Learning Portal.

q: How is the online study material made available to the students?
a: The course study material for the online programme is designed with a four-quadrant approach and is available to students on the University’s LMS:
list: Quadrant-I, i.e., e-Tutorial, faculty-led video and audio contents
Quadrant-II, i.e., e-Content with illustrations, video demonstrations, documents as required.
Quadrant-III, i.e., discussion forums for doubt clarifications. Responses to which shall be provided by the course coordinator(s). Peer interaction is also supported.
Quadrant-IV, i.e., self-assessment, in the form of MCQs, problems, quizzes, assignments with solutions.

q: What kind of networking opportunities are available to MBA students?
a: Students gain access to virtual networking events, discussion forums, mentorship, webinars with industry leaders for enhanced professional connections.

q: How will the programme delivery be done?
a: The programme delivery will be fully online ensuring flexibility and accessibility for all students. Live, interactive lectures will be conducted by course coordinators on weekends.

q: What kind of support will online learners receive from the programme?
a: The four-quadrant course design approach will ensure a seamless and engaging learning experience. Dedicated course mentors will provide learning support to the students.

q: Will students be provided mentorship during the programme?
a: Yes. Guidance and mentoring from course coordinators will help students to navigate any academic challenges. Dedicated mentors to assist in learning and academic-related support.

q: How will evaluations be done during the programme?
a: A student shall be assessed for a course through Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA) and Semester End Examination (SEE). CIA and SEE will have 30:70 percent weightage, respectively.

q: What career options are available after completing the MBA programme?
a: Students can explore professions in Financial Management, Marketing Management, Human Resource Management, IT & Systems Management, Supply Chain Management, Entrepreneurship, Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

q: How is the curriculum made?
a: The curriculum of the online MBA programme has been crafted by management experts; it thoughtfully incorporates contemporary business and management topics alongside courses fostering contemporary business awareness.
